q1_issues.issue: (Holder sk_require_1 sk_recipe_1) gives the by-phrase a possession role, but the passive rule says a by-phrase takes the role the active subject would have had, Agent for a transitive even a stative or inanimate one, and explicitly "never Holder, which is possession-only".

notes: The rest is what the active voice would emit: event class require, Theme on the counted egg group (GroupOf + Cardinality 2), and no tense atom on the unmarked present. "required" here has no elided "to V" and norms no party, so the kind-level deontic (obligated ...) form does not apply and the ordinary passive event is the right reading.
